name: Cathedral of Tallow
text: Mirrored pillars, a little rubble and a Votive Shrine. Vigil Night 1.
flavor: Pillars of old wax hold up a vault of smoke-stained glass.

name: Soot Market
text: Heaps of rubble that stop slides, and a pair of Chimneys.
flavor: Overturned stalls and spilled wares, and every shadow sells something.

name: Belfry Steps
text: Staggered lanes of pillars and pools of Hot Wax.
flavor: Stone lanes climb between bell-pillars, slick with fallen wax.

name: The Waxworks
text: Hot Wax everywhere, Chimneys, and a Smokestack coughing up Sootlings.
flavor: Vats of molten wax bubble beneath a coughing smokestack.
